strings.Авторское учебное изложение проверенных: Author's training summary of verified provisions, not a website facsimile
strings.Адресат жалобы на работника МФЦ: Recipient of a complaint about an MFC employee
strings.В журнале на момент жалобы отметки об от: At the time of the complaint, the register had no dispatch entry.
strings.В контрольном эпизоде руководитель удовл: In the follow-up episode, the director upheld the complaint. Only an employee's verbal message arrived: “We'll sort everything out now”; there is no documentary confirmation.
strings.Все жалобы на любого работника всегда на: All complaints about any employee must always be sent only to the founder.
strings.Все жалобы независимо от предмета рассма: All complaints, regardless of subject, are reviewed in exactly 30 calendar days.
strings.Выполняйте действия в пределах своей рол: Act within your role. Independent actions may be performed in different orders.
strings.Выслушайте обращение и уточните факты. Н: Listen to the appeal and clarify the facts. The case title does not determine which actions are correct.
strings.Данные о принятом пакете исключают автом: The information showing that the package was accepted rules out automatically classifying this incident as a refusal to accept it.
strings.Для данного предмета жалобы применяется: This complaint subject has a period of 15 working days from registration.
strings.Для решения о прекращении переписки учит: A decision to end correspondence takes account of repeated prior substantive replies, absence of new arguments or circumstances, and statutory conditions. Letter count alone is insufficient.
strings.Для уже опубликованной информации допуст: For information already published, a reply may identify the publication or the official website address where it appears. Verify that the requested information is actually on that official website. A direct link is more convenient, but is not itself the only format permitted by law.
strings.Документы приняли или отказали в приёме?: Were the documents accepted or refused?
strings.Документы приняли, расписку выдали. Но в: My documents were accepted and a receipt issued. But the body says the package has not arrived from the multifunctional service centre. The register extract shows that the forwarding deadline has passed. I am complaining about the centre employee's delay in forwarding it.
The supplement has been added to the case file.
strings.Достаточно поручить окончательный ответ: It is enough to instruct the employee being complained about to give the final response.
strings.Если решение вопросов не относится к ком: If the issues lie outside the recipient's powers, the written appeal is forwarded to the competent body or official and the citizen is notified. An address does not establish authority.
strings.Жалоба на нарушение работником МФЦ поряд: A complaint about a multifunctional service centre employee's breach of the procedure for forwarding accepted documents has been registered. It does not concern refusal to accept documents or correction of an error. The exercise uses the general procedure in Chapter 2.1 of Law No. 210-ФЗ, without a special federal procedure or shortened period.
strings.Жалобу на решения и действия работника М: A complaint about a service centre employee's decisions and actions goes to that centre's director. Do not confuse a centre employee with the body providing the service.
strings.Жалобу на решения и действия самого МФЦ: A complaint about the service centre's own decisions and actions goes to its founding authority or an official authorised by a regulatory legal act of the constituent entity.
strings.Жалобу нельзя направить на рассмотрение: A complaint must not be referred for consideration to the body or official whose decision, action or inaction is challenged.
strings.Задержана передача уже принятых документ: Forwarding of already accepted documents is delayed. Do not confuse this with storage of the completed result or the appointment booking date.
strings.Задержка передачи уже принятых документо: Delayed forwarding of documents already accepted.
strings.Закон отдельно устанавливает направление: The law separately requires a reasoned response to be sent no later than the day following the decision. This is not another review period.
strings.Запрос информации о деятельности власти: A request for information on public-authority activities
strings.Запрос информации рассматривается по спе: An information request follows special rules. If the information does not concern the recipient's activities, apply referral to the competent body with notification to the user.
strings.Изучите статью 11.2. По условиям дела об: Study Article 11.2. The case concerns a complaint about an MFC employee's actions. Enter the recipient's official role, not their surname.
strings.Найдите норму и проверьте её применимост: Find the provision and check its applicability. A source page does not replace justification of the decision.
strings.Найдите норму о сроке рассмотрения именн: Find the rule on the review period for this specific type of pre-trial complaint.
strings.Не направлять ответ, если нарушение приз: Do not send a response if the violation has been acknowledged.
strings.Нужно отличать действие работника от реш: Distinguish an employee's action from a decision by the centre itself. In this case, the complaint is addressed to the head of the MFC.
strings.Общий срок рассмотрения письменного обра: The general written-appeal consideration period is tied to registration. It is not a universal deadline for construction, repairs or pollution removal.
strings.Окончательно рассмотреть жалобу силами т: Have only the employee complained about conduct the final review of the complaint.
strings.Орган обеспечивает объективное, всесторо: The body ensures objective, comprehensive and timely consideration, requests materials where needed and provides a substantive reply. An appeal does not replace a budget decision.
strings.Орган определяет подразделение или должн: The body designates the unit or officials responsible for information access. Publishing a law on a ministry website does not mean that ministry holds every requested local document.
strings.Отказ исправить опечатку в выданном резу: Refusal to correct a typo in an issued result.
strings.Пакет принят. По учебным материалам срок: The package was accepted. The training materials show the internal forwarding deadline has expired and no confirmation of forwarding is available. Refusal to accept documents is not alleged.
strings.Передача пакета из МФЦ. Итоговый срок са: Forwarding the package from the service centre. I am not currently challenging the final deadline for the service itself.
strings.Подготовить материалы и проект решения д: Prepare materials and a draft decision for the MFC director
strings.Подготовить мотивированный ответ после п: Prepare a reasoned response within the prescribed time after the decision is made
strings.Подменить досудебную жалобу обычным обра: Replace a pre-trial complaint with an ordinary submission requiring a month's wait
strings.Помощник: «Решение о жалобе можно вынест: Assistant: “You can decide the complaint and send the response a month later.”
strings.Посетитель находится у стойки; перед сот: A visitor stands at the counter; a stack of materials lies in the officer's incoming tray.
strings.После принятия решения заявителю направл: After the decision, a reasoned reply must be sent to the applicant no later than the following day. This is a separate action, not a new full complaint consideration period.
strings.Потребовать от заявителя заново доказать: Require the applicant to prove already-reviewed arguments again without a reason.
strings.Потребовать от органа, предоставляющего: Require the service authority to answer for the MFC employee's actions without distinguishing responsibilities.
strings.Правило исчисления в этом учебном деле:: Calculation rule for this training case: the initial day is excluded. Count working days in Russia's five-day working week; no regional additions apply. The end of such a period already falls on a working day.
strings.Предмет – передача пакета работником МФЦ: The subject is forwarding the package by a service centre employee.
strings.При нескольких вопросах, относящихся к р: Where several issues belong to different bodies, copies of the appeal are forwarded to the appropriate recipients. Keep the issues distinguishable.
They accepted them. I have a numbered receipt.
strings.Проверить действия по устранению нарушен: Check the steps taken to remedy the violation and that a reasoned response has been sent to the applicant.
strings.Проверить регистрацию жалобы и указанный: Check complaint registration and its stated subject
strings.Проверить фактическое устранение нарушен: Check that the violation has actually been remedied if the complaint is upheld
Check whether the follow-up actions are complete.
strings.Прошу проверить задержку передачи пакета: Please investigate the service centre employee's delay in forwarding my package. I am not asking to correct a typo or appealing refusal to accept documents.
strings.Разделить рассмотрение жалобы и направле: Separate review of the complaint from dispatch of the reasoned response; check Part 8 of Article 11.2.
strings.Рассчитайте последний день рассмотрения: Calculate the final day for reviewing the complaint. Do not confuse it with the separate deadline for sending a reasoned response after the decision. The case specifies no special shortening or separate procedure.
strings.Руководителю этого МФЦ: жалоба на его ра: To this MFC's director: the complaint concerns their employee.
strings.Самостоятельно назначить услугу вместо к: Approve the service independently in place of the competent authority
strings.Сначала установите событие и единицы счё: First identify the starting event and counting units, then find the exact date. The calendar does not choose the applicable law for you.
strings.Согласиться, добавив новый месячный срок: Agree, adding a new one-month period.
strings.Сопоставить изложенные доводы с документ: Compare the stated arguments with the documents and the employee's actions
strings.Сотрудник приёмной МФЦ выходит за полном: The MFC reception employee exceeds their authority regarding provision of the service.
strings.Срок определяется датой, когда работник: The deadline is determined by the date on which the employee wishes to reply.
strings.Считать устное обещание выполненным реше: Treat the verbal promise as an implemented decision.
strings.Удовлетворение жалобы, сообщение заявите: Upholding the complaint, informing the applicant and actually remedying the violation must be distinguished.
strings.Учебная стажировка у руководителя МФЦ. Ж: A training placement with the MFC director. The complaint concerns an employee of this centre, not the director or a decision of the service authority. You prepare materials for the authorised person, but do not approve the service or impose sanctions.
strings.Часть 1 статьи 11.2 разграничивает адрес: Part 1 of Article 11.2 distinguishes recipients. Here an employee's action is challenged, so the centre's head is appropriate.
strings.руководителю МФЦ: to the head of the MFC
strings.руководителю многофункционального центра: to the head of the multifunctional centre
